text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: inference-queue-backlog service - SEV: critical - page fired (queue_depth > 1000 for 5m) :rotating_light:

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Page triggered for service 'inference-queue-backlog' at 5249991234. Acknowledge required.

ryan (oncall): ack - I'm on it. pulling metrics + checking autoscaler.

maria: seeing a steady increase in pending requests on the inference queue. per-shard depth ~ 1200, aggregated ~ 4800. tail latency climbing.

ryan (oncall): autoscaler logs look weird — controller shows "scaler: evaluation_jitter" and a backlog checkpoint but no new nodes requested. anyone changed autoscaler config?

maria: no config changes in the last 30m from infra team. autoscale policy still: target_util 0.65, max_replicas 200.

eva: looks like cloud provider is returning insufficient quota errors to the node provisioner. saw repeated `quota_exceeded` in node-launcher logs.

infra-lead: confirming: provider quota pool exhausted in us-west-2 for GPU-pool-1. fallback pools still available but not in routing policy for this service.

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook snippet: "If quota_exceeded prevents autoscale, temporarily route traffic to backup pool or enable burst_dedicated=true for affected service." Steps:
1) enable burst_dedicated on service config
2) route ~30% of traffic to dedicated-pool-02
3) manually scale dedicated-pool-02 if needed

ryan (oncall): doing step 1 -> flipping burst flag now.

ryan (oncall): Command I ran:
```
redwoodctl services update inference-queue-backlog --set burst_dedicated=true --reason "PD page: quota exhausted us-west-2"
```

maria: good call. I'll adjust routing to send a portion to dedicated-pool-02. applying split weighting 70/30.

maria: routing command:
```
redwoodctl routing update inference-queue-backlog --split "us-west-2:70,dedicated-pool-02:30"
```

pagerduty: If not acknowledged by next tier within 10m, will escalate.

customer-support: Customer impact note: we're seeing increased 500/503 for customers on us-west-2 starting ~5249991100. Affected: a subset of realtime inference customers (IDs redacted). We'll post an interim status page update: "Degraded performance and intermittent errors for a subset of customers in US-WEST."

eva: after routing change, dedicated-pool-02 accepted nodes but needed a manual scale command due to slow node boot. scaling to 40 instances.

ryan (oncall): manual scale command executed:
```
redwoodctl pool scale dedicated-pool-02 --replicas 40 --force
```

maria: queue depth started to plateau ~5m after routing change. per-shard depth down to ~600. retries from application layer caused some duplicate requests; we're rate-limiting retries for now.

infra-lead: working with cloud team to raise quota request but ETA is hours. for immediate mitigation we should keep burst_dedicated on and consider increasing routing to 50% if queue still not draining.

customer-support: posted customer notice with tag "investigating" and affected regions. CS will contact top-tier customers directly.

ryan (oncall): handing off primary lead to eva — I need to jump to another page. Summary for next shift: autoscaler failed to provision due to provider quota_exceeded; mitigated by routing to dedicated-pool-02 + manual scale. watch for duplicate-processing and KV-cache pressure.

eva: ack, taking over. I'll watch queue and latency, coordinate with infra for quota.

ops-runbook-bot: Reminder: mark incident with tag `quota-fallback` and add the autoscaler logs to the incident timeline. Suggested postmortem checklist updated.

maria: monitoring: tail latency back to normal for routed traffic, overall 5xx rate down 85%. queue depth trending down.

eva: increasing routing split to 50/50 to speed drain. command:
```
redwoodctl routing update inference-queue-backlog --split "us-west-2:50,dedicated-pool-02:50" --reason "drain backlog faster"
```

pagerduty: Noted - no escalation required at this time.

customer-support: follow-up note: updated status page to "Mitigated - partial traffic routed to dedicated pool, queue backlog draining. Working on quota request."

eva: queue drained below 100 aggregate. will keep burst_dedicated=true for 30m and then revert if autoscaler healthy.

infra-lead: opening quota request with provider (ticket #PROV-8421). adding urgency.

ryan (oncall): thanks all. I'm back and see things stable. will validate autoscaler behavior over next 15m then close page.

eva: autoscaler now evaluating normally; no further quota errors in last 10m.

ops-runbook-bot: If stable for 30m, mark incident resolved and file follow-up: "investigate autoscaler visibility into provider quota state".

eva: marking resolved for now. final notes: root cause = provider GPU quota exhaustion causing autoscaler to fail to provision. mitigation = route to dedicated pool + manual scale. follow-ups: quota increase, make fallback routing automatic, alert on provider quota_exceeded metric.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: incident resolved at 5249991320. Page closed. :white_check_mark:
